name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 38 – Am 19
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 38. Expresses deep concern that the lack of ring-fenced funding for the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+) renders the 14 % social target purely aspirational rather than binding; strongly maintains the view that this structural flaw exposes social policies to constant budgetary pressure, thereby eroding the fund’s specific purpose; calls, therefore, for the ESF+ to remain a stand-alone and separate programme outside the NRPP with a dedicated financial envelope of EUR198 billion in current prices(equivalent to EUR177 billion in 2025 constant prices) for promoting upwards social convergence, quality employment and equal opportunities; stresses that the ESF remains a key financing instrument for investing in education, employment, quality job creation, quality working conditions, and reinforcing the workforce and skills development, fostering equality and providing for people in vulnerable situations and those most in need in our societies, delivering on the targets of the EPSR action plan; deeply regrets the narrow social dimension of the proposed NRPP Regulation; calls for clarity and predictability to be guaranteed for final beneficiaries and the responsible managing authorities;
